topic: How tap to pay works (power-first hook)

lines.say: Before a card machine can take your money, it has to give your card power.
lines.show: Before a card machine can *take your money,* it has to [give your card power.]

lines.say: Your bank card has no battery. So how does it talk to the machine the moment you tap?
lines.show: Your bank card has *no battery.* So how does it talk to the machine the moment [you tap?]

lines.say: The machine makes an invisible magnetic field that keeps changing.
lines.show: The machine makes an *invisible magnetic field* that [keeps changing.]

lines.say: Around the edge of your card hides a coil of wire.
lines.show: Around the edge of your card hides a [coil of wire.]

lines.say: Bring it close, and the field creates just enough electricity in the coil to wake the chip.
lines.show: Bring it close, and the field creates just enough *electricity* in the coil to [wake the chip.]

lines.say: The chip answers through the same field. It doesn't just send your card number. It adds a one-time code that only works for this payment.
lines.show: The chip answers through the same field. It doesn't just send your card number. It adds a *one-time code* that [only works for this payment.]

lines.say: At a café, the machine usually sends that to your bank, which checks the code and approves or declines, within seconds.
lines.show: At a café, the machine usually sends that to your bank, which checks the code and *approves or declines,* [within seconds.]

lines.say: In twenty fourteen, London let people tap bank cards right onto the Tube.
lines.show: In 2014, London let people tap bank cards right onto the [Tube.]

lines.say: But a gate can't wait for the bank, so it checks the card is genuine on the spot, fast enough for you to keep walking. The bank checks the payment later.
lines.show: But a gate *can't wait* for the bank, so it checks the card is *genuine* on the spot, fast enough for you to keep walking. The bank checks the payment [later.]

lines.say: So your card is just plastic, until the machine wakes it up with electricity.
lines.show: So your card is just plastic, until the machine wakes it up with [electricity.]
